# Usage

## Quarto {#sec-usage-quarto}

### Rendering

```rocq
Definition negb (b : bool) : bool :=
  match b with
  | true  => false
  | false => true
  end.
```

### Source

````default
```rocq
Definition negb (b : bool) : bool :=
  match b with
  | true  => false
  | false => true
  end.
```
````

## Typst {#sec-usage-typst}

### Rendering

When you compile your `.typ` file, the code blocks will be rendered using PanRocq in the `.pdf` file. As an example, you can look at this [exercise sheet](https://matematiflo.github.io/PanRocq/Typst/Exercises.pdf).

```bash
typst c Typst/Exercises.typ
```

### Source

````default
```rocq
Inductive list (A : Type) : Type :=
| nil  : list A
| cons : A → list A → list A.
```
````
